agent_explanation: Noisy angle/rate feedback with seed 1 at large dt~0.0199 causes state-feedback controller to apply wrong-phase forces (e.g. ~12-17 units early while pole reverses from +0.1). Pole rate grows increasingly negative (-1.1 at step5, -3.2 at step10, -5.3 at step15) and angle swings from +0.1 to -0.59 to -0.698 to -0.81 at step17, crossing 0.8 limit. Zeroing noise with identical plant/dt/seed removes failure, confirming noise-driven loss of stabilization, not force saturation (force <42.5) or track limit.
